snippet.title: Nekome: Nazi Hunter Galaxies Showcase Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Vano Nastasu is a young Romani man whose family was murdered by Nazi soldiers. This third-person action game follows him from hunted to hunter as he takes his revenge across a war-torn world. It's inspired by grindhouse cinema and mixes stealth with brutal close-quarters combat. It's coming to PS5, Xbox Series and PC in early 2027.
